confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'the issue is almost certainly the aged cells struggling to deliver current under load'

unjustifiedPart.evidence: 'a new battery is likely your best option'; 'It is usually worth it'

rationale: The assistant never asked for the model label (SV11/V7), never asked whether the cut-out is pulsing or a clean stop, and never asked about the lights, so it could not know which battery to recommend. It moved from 'very likely' to 'almost certainly' the battery while the customer said they couldn't swap-test, and it never suggested Dyson support or checking the charger pins before spending £60+. The Max-mode and partly-used evidence was used well, and it did note some uncertainty in turn 2, but the final answer was overconfident and repetitive.
